items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You were talking about the Volkswagen commercial where – I think Jimmie Crawford was in that? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Crawford’s on drums. Snooky.

ctx.x: In general, that same number – that same group of people who were on staff were generally the ones who were called – on first call of all – you see there were several contractors in town. One contractor couldn’t possibly handle all the jingles. So they had several people who were officiating in the capacity of contractor. All the studios, the first call came off the list. Each studio – there must have been at least 50 people on each studio’s – I would say there were a couple of hundred people who did almost all…
You were talking about the Volkswagen commercial where – I think Jimmie Crawford was in that?
